thread:
carla: quick heads-up — PR #578 (docs: sdk-examples) is failing the Vercel preview with an asset hash mismatch. local mkdocs build shows the svg fine but preview 404s. holding merge until we confirm previews
ben: which asset/path?
carla: /assets/diagrams/serve-graph.svg. local comes out as /_assets/serve-graph.4f2a.svg, vercel shows /_assets/serve-graph.7b9c.svg and then 404. also saw a different hash in the HTML references.
alice: that smells like nondeterministic fingerprinting from our static asset pipeline. we bumped a dependency in the last docs release, might have regressed the hash algorithm.
ben: i rebuilt locally twice and hashes changed between builds for me — so it's reproducible locally.
carla: excerpt from the Vercel build logs:
```
11:03:12  Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open './site/assets/diagrams/serve-graph.svg'
11:03:12  Warning: Asset fingerprint mismatch detected: expected 4f2a != 7b9c
```
carla: i temporarily pushed the svg into docs/static (instead of docs/assets) to force include; preview redeployed but html still references the old hash.
david: tagging in — i'll review the PR diff and check our mkdocs build step. if the hashing is non-deterministic we'll need to pin the plugin or adjust the build to use content-based hashes. also want to avoid serving mixed hashes from CDN.
alice: quick local repro steps for anyone who wants to verify:
```
git checkout pr/578
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build -d site
python -m http.server --directory site 8001
open http://127.0.0.1:8001
```
ben: for merges i'd prefer we schedule in the low-traffic merge window tonight at 21:30 PST so if we need to roll back it's quick. @carla ok to hold until then?
carla: yes holding for 21:30 PST. requesting reviews from @david and @ben. i'll leave the PR unmerged and add the vercel logs to the PR description.
david: i'll run a clean build on a fresh machine and then check the CDN object names. if hashes are unstable we'll either pin the mkdocs plugin version or switch to deterministic hashing (sha256 of content). will report back within the merge window.
ben: if anyone needs to re-run the Vercel preview checks, use the deploy bot in the PR UI or re-run the vercel/preview job from CI. watch the network tab for requested asset URLs before and after a redeploy.
docs-bot: reminder — PR #578 has failing check `vercel/preview` (1 failure). To re-run the preview, add the comment `ci re-run vercel/preview` or trigger a redeploy from the Vercel dashboard.
carla: thanks all — i'll keep the PR tagged `merge-window: tonight` and post an update once david confirms the build reproducibility. if anyone sees the preview succeed after a redeploy, drop a quick ack here.
david: quick status update: fresh build reproduced hash flip. i'm running a test with the mkdocs-fingerprint plugin pinned to the previous version. will push a branch for testing and attach the diff to the PR.
ben: nice. once there's a deterministic build, i'm happy to approve and we can merge in tonight's window.
carla: appreciated.
